messages:
Alex S: forwarding customer email below — request for VAT reverse charge / exemption (DE VAT ID provided). can someone confirm the exact docs we need to issue a 0% invoice?

Customer email (pasted):
Lina, Acme GmbH: Hi Redwood team — We are an EU business (DE VAT ID DE123456789). Can you issue invoices net of VAT under the reverse-charge mechanism? Also need invoices to show our PO# 2024-ACME-77. Please advise what proof you need. Thanks, Lina

Alex S: copied PO and vat id in our billing system. flagged for finance. @priya.b can you advise?

Priya B: quick checklist: 1) confirm company VAT ID via VIES 2) have billing address matching DE registration 3) capture PO number on invoice 4) mark invoice with standard reverse-charge note.

Priya B: also need written confirmation that the purchase is for business (not a consumer). a VIES confirmation screenshot or a company registration excerpt is fine.

Alex S: did VIES check come back positive? I ran vat-checker-bot but got a timeout.

vat-checker-bot: VIES lookup for DE123456789 — FAILED (service timeout). Please retry or attach customer-provided VIES validation screenshot.

Tom L: from a tax perspective we can apply reverse charge if: customer is a taxable person in another EU member state, VAT ID validated, and invoice contains the reverse charge statement. Wording we use: \"Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer under Article 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC. Customer VAT ID: DE123456789.\"

Tom L: also confirm the place of supply is outside the supplier's VAT country for the service. For digital services to businesses, that's standard.

Alex S: customer replied with VIES PDF screenshot and DE business registration PDF attached to the email. They also said PO must appear on invoice.

Priya B: perfect — please upload attachments to the billing ticket and I'll generate a revised invoice. Steps I'll take: set account metadata tax_exempt = true, vat_id = "DE123456789", invoice_note = "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer".

Priya B: sample invoice footer we will use:
```
Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer under Article 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC. Customer VAT ID: DE123456789. Invoice issued net of VAT.
```

Maya M: FYI remind engineering: when we set tax_exempt = true we must ensure hosted billing engine doesn't still calculate VAT. last time a migration left a VAT line on export. Priya pls confirm preview before sending.

Priya B: yes will create a draft, post URL here for review.

Alex S: customer asked if we can backdate invoice to cover last billing period (Feb 10–Mar 9). is that allowed?

Tom L: we can reissue invoices for that period if the services were supplied to the business and proof covers that timeframe. include note "reissued under reverse charge upon customer request". keep audit trail.

Priya B: created draft invoice #R-2024-578 (preview: https://redwood.internal/billing/previews/R-2024-578). draft includes PO 2024-ACME-77, reverse-charge note, and no VAT line. please review.

Alex S: reviewed — looks good to me. sending to customer now. Lina — we'll send the final invoice as requested, please confirm PO on_payment.

Customer reply (via email): Lina, Acme GmbH: thanks, that works. Please send final invoice to accounting@acme.de.

Alex S: done. closing loop. marking thread resolved in support ticket. :white_check_mark:
